traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text:
The domovoi's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

At will: alter self, invisibility

3/day each: darkness, dimension door, haste

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The domovoi makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
